chunks: Abu Abdillah عليه السلام was asked about a free man who marries a bondwoman belonging to a people: are the children slaves or free? He said:
"The children are free." Then he said: "If one of his parents is free, then the child is free."

key_terms.بِأَمَةِ: to a bondwoman or female slave

ai.seo_question: If a free man marries a bondwoman, are their children free or enslaved?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the status of children born from a free man and a bondwoman. Imam Abu Abdillah عليه السلام states that the child is free when one of the two parents is free, establishing a principle in family law and the rulings of slavery.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4580 - Abu Abdillah (as) was asked about a free man who marries a bondwoman belonging to a people. Are the children considered slaves or free?

Imam (as) said: "The children are free."
Then Imam (as) added: "If one of the parents is free, the child is free."
